steps: Log into Liberty Online Banking or the Liberty app.
Go to MENU > Services > Refer-a-Friend; your code auto-generates.
Tap Email or Text to share the auto-generated message with your friend.
Friend opens a new LSB checking account and makes one debit card purchase; you receive $50 within 10 business days.
timing: $50 deposited within 10 business days after the friend qualifies.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: $50 deposited within 10 business days after the friend qualifies. — the payout window is ~2 weeks after qualification.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
